title: Health, Non-Communicable Diseases and Plant Tissues

flashcard_questions.q: A state of complete physical and mental well-being, not merely the absence of disease or infirmity.
Diseases caused by pathogens (bacteria, viruses, fungi, protists) that can be passed from one organism to another.
Diseases that cannot be transmitted between organisms — they are often long-term and linked to lifestyle or genetic factors.

flashcard_questions.a: A tumour that is contained in one area, usually within a membrane, and does not spread to other parts of the body.
Something that increases the likelihood of developing a disease — can be a lifestyle choice, a substance in the body, or an environmental factor.
